import json,datetime
from src.tools.t01v2_live_progress import ROOT,read_prefix,archive,observed_counts,expected_identity
name="t01v2_fov_progress_04"
directory=ROOT/'logs/runs'/name/'evidence';directory.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
rows=[]
for source in ["pilot_pairs_v2_fov100_living201_01_j707493_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan201","pilot_pairs_v2_fov60_living202_01_j707495_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan202"]:
 expected=expected_identity(source)
 raw,extent=read_prefix(ROOT/'data/world_pairs/v2'/(source+'_attempts.jsonl'))
 rows.append({'source_run':source,'scene':expected['scene'],'snapshot':archive(raw,directory,source+'_journal.prefix'),'extent':extent,'counts':observed_counts(raw,expected['scene'])})
print('OBSERVED_FOV_PROGRESS: '+json.dumps({'snapshot_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'scope':'source-reported complete journal prefixes only; running source not finally audited and passes not independently accepted','rows':rows},sort_keys=True))
